JXPATH-12.label: I
JXPATH-12.reason: This report is about the descendant-or-self axis at the root node and incorrect handling of `@id/text()` selection in XML navigation. The current failure is in `ExtensionFunctionTest.testNodeSetReturn()`, specifically how an extension function returning a `NodeSet` is iterated and unwrapped into values/pointers. The shared domain is only broad XPath/JXPath traversal, but the mechanism is different: axis resolution at the root versus extension-function return type handling and pointer iteration.
